# Portable Math {#sec-math}

This page renders the commands in the math style guide with MathJax,
so a change in a renderer shows up.
The guide's PDF renders the same commands with pdfLaTeX.

Bold: $\boldsymbol{x}_{i, t}$, $\boldsymbol{A}$, $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}$;
elements: $a_{12, i}$.

Operators: $\operatorname{vec} \! \left( \boldsymbol{A} \right)$,
$\operatorname{tr} \! \left( \boldsymbol{A} \right)$,
$\boldsymbol{A}^{\prime}$,
$\mathbb{E} \! \left( x \right)$,
$\mathcal{N} \! \left( \boldsymbol{0}, \boldsymbol{\Xi} \right)$,
$\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{x} f \! \left( x \right)$,
$\mathrm{B}$.

$$
\boldsymbol{\eta}_{i, t}
=
\boldsymbol{\alpha}
+ \boldsymbol{B} \boldsymbol{\eta}_{i, t - 1}
+ \boldsymbol{\zeta}_{i, t},
\quad
\boldsymbol{\zeta}_{i, t}
\sim \mathcal{N} \! \left( \boldsymbol{0}, \boldsymbol{\Psi} \right)
$$

$$
\mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{\eta}_{i, t}
=
\boldsymbol{\Phi} \left( \boldsymbol{\eta}_{i, t} - \boldsymbol{\mu} \right) \, \mathrm{d} t
+ \boldsymbol{\Sigma}^{\frac{1}{2}} \, \mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{W}_{i, t}
$$

$$
\exp \! \left( \Delta t \boldsymbol{\Phi} \right),
\quad
\boldsymbol{D}_{\boldsymbol{m}},
\quad
\hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}},
\quad
\sum_{i = 1}^{n} x_{i}
$$
